label: SYNTHETIC DATA / SIMULATED OPERATION / OFFLINE EVALUATION / NOT PRODUCTION DEPLOYED. Classes describe failures of the synthetic lab; none is a production incident.

severity_scale.SEV1: A safety invariant was violated (an unapproved mutation, an external action, an ungrounded executed claim). Design target: page immediately.
severity_scale.SEV2: A dependency or the evaluation signal is lost or unsafe behaviour was attempted; the system is degraded or must stop promoting changes.
severity_scale.SEV3: A fault occurred and the system contained it (escalated or abstained); a human should look at the next review cycle.
severity_scale.SEV4: Informational: something unusual was observed and handled.

classes.expected_containment: planner returns ESCALATE_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with planner_failure=true; no mutating action is proposed
bounded retry (2) then escalate; invalid output never becomes an action
the failed check becomes a gap; the planner escalates instead of concluding no-action
the failed check becomes a gap; short cover with unconfirmed supplier escalates
output schema validation rejects the result (MALFORMED_RESULT); it never reaches a claim
input validation rejects the call (INVALID_ARGUMENTS); nothing executes
policy lookups fail closed (abstain) or fall back to the lexical retriever; no policy claim without a citation
abstain with INSUFFICIENT VERIFIED EVIDENCE; unconfirmed policy is listed as an uncertainty
stale, superseded or unverified sources are excluded or flagged and never cited as authority
no grant is minted; the run stays awaiting a permitted reviewer; nothing executes
an expired session or stale pending review cannot approve; nothing executes; the review can be re-opened
forbidden, unknown, tainted or unapproved tool requests are refused and counted; external actions never execute
tool reads fail as UPSTREAM_FAILURE and the run escalates; a crash marks the run FAILED so the event can be re-processed
the run is marked FAILED (not left RUNNING); no mutation has executed
planner output unusable => escalate; guardrail overrides are counted
timeouts bound every call; slow-but-successful calls are visible in latency metrics
the regression gate fails; the candidate version is not promoted; rollback is the recovery
should never fire: a mutation without a prior approval, or an external action performed
burn-rate alert pages before the error budget is exhausted (design-target SLOs)

correlation_note: When a run raises a parent-class alert, alerts of the child classes on the SAME run are attached to the parent incident instead of opening their own.
